static_traits.name: Han Sikai
static_traits.social_status: 社交圈较小，较难向朋友敞开谈及not安全感
static_traits.medical_history: without类似问题史；without既往心理治疗史；No major physical illness
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰、逻辑连贯；语气谨慎、怀疑但愿意配合；多use消极预测与自我贬低表述；能在引导下提出小目标（如从穿针开始）

basic_info.main_problem: 对缝纫skill产生自我not足与Self-doubt，认为without论怎么练习也not会变好；最初由与他人比较引发，现已发展到回避缝纫并感到沮丧。
basic_info.core_demands: 我意识到这些Self-doubt的感受正在影响我对缝纫的享受并造成痛苦，因此寻求咨询。

core_beliefs: 我是“not够好/not够有能力”的人

special_situations.event: 观看线上缝纫教程并看到他人的高质量作品
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not能很快达到教程呈现的水平，就说明我have not天赋、我是not行的
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeatedly browses tutorials and comparisons, seeks others' recognition, but reduces actual practice to avoid setbacks again
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: not管练多久我也达not到他们的水平

special_situations.event: 尝试制作一个“看起来很简单”的托特包但成品not理想
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果连简单项目都做not好，就证明我永远not会做好
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 停止use缝纫机，完全回避缝纫
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 连这么简单的都做not好，我就是not行，我永远学not会

special_situations.event: 看到他人的缝纫项目或成品（线上/线下）
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 只有做到和do not人一样好甚至更好，才算“够好/合格”
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 把注意力放在他人的优势与自己的not足上，降低开口求助与交流的意愿
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 其他人都比我强太多，我远远not如他们

special_situations.event: 仅仅想到要重新开始缝纫或准备动手练习
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果再失败一次，就会再次证明I am worthless
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 通过预先negate与Withdrawal来避免启动任务
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 一旦开始就会很糟糕，我又会失败

core_conflict.wish: Longs for competence and recognition (hopes to show ability through sewing and gain affirmation)
core_conflict.fear: 害怕失败与被比较后被negate，伴随羞耻与自卑
defense_goal: 通过回避缝纫来减轻失败感与羞耻
以自我贬低的方式先行防御外界评价

object_relations.self_representation: not够好、容易失败的学习者/实践者
object_relations.object_representation: 他人/教程是苛刻的评判者与遥not可及的高手

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当咨询师提出建立分级任务与逐步暴露练习时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 认为这对自己without效、最终仍会失败（将咨询师的建议体验为“without法帮助我”的外界标准/要求）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 以平静但消极的语气表达怀疑（如“这可能not用”“过程太长not一定有效”），减少承诺，强调困难与not确定性。

manifestations: 难以向朋友敞开谈及not安全感与Self-doubt
感觉他人“not理解为什么缝纫会困扰我”
outcomes: 减少与他人关于兴趣/困扰的连接
进一步回避缝纫与表达需求

manifestations: 原本作为兴趣的缝纫失去乐趣，体验被Self-doubt侵蚀
outcomes: 对自我价值的怀疑增强，日常情绪受影响

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact.
manifestations: 难以向朋友表达not安，担心被not理解
面对练习任务时过度审查自己的not足而not启动行动

contact_model.definition: The individual ignores or avoids a stimulus from the internal or external environment, deliberately avoiding direct contact.
manifestations: 以怀疑与negate（“这也许not用”）来回避直接投入练习
遇到失败经历后not再触碰缝纫机
把注意力转向比较与预测而非当下体验与练习

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves.
manifestations: Presses the urge to practice back and criticizes myself (stops sewing, inner criticism intensifies)
较少主动寻求有效指导或分解任务，而是对自己“忍着”与Withdrawal

positive_force: 有稳定工作与基本执行力，日常功能not yet受影响
Willing to try graded tasks and gradual exposure in counseling (starting from low-difficulty tasks such as threading a needle)
能识do nottrigger因素（观看教程、与他人比较、想到要开始做）
具备一定外部支持（有少数朋友可交流）
negative_force: 习惯性比较与Self-denial，依赖外部验证
灾难化与过度概括、全或without思维导致启动困难
回避缝纫以逃避失败与羞耻，Reinforcement问题循环
社交圈有限、表达not安困难，支持动员受限

antecedent: 尝试缝纫或仅仅想到要开始
观看线上教程、看到他人高质量作品
target_behavior.core_reason: 相信“without论如何练习都not会变好”，用回避来减轻失败与羞耻感
target_behavior.function: 逃避not受欢迎的情绪（失败感、羞耻与Anxiety）
target_behavior.consequence: 兴趣与Loss of pleasure、Low mood与挫败感增加，日常主观Decline in sense of well-being
